13040.name: The Grand Hall Of Records

east.description: To the east lies A Long Corridor.

13040.description:
Shelves of black oak climb into the gloom of the Grand Hall Of Records,
each one crowded with scroll cases, ledgers and cracked tablets that
chronicle the kings of Durmandel. Dust lies thick on the reading desks,
and a cold, dry smell of old parchment hangs in the air. A single
archway opens east onto a long corridor, and the dim light from it
barely reaches the farthest stacks.

13115.name: At The End Of A Long Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Long Corridor.

down.description: To the down lies The Grand Stairs.

13115.description:
The long hallway comes to its end here at a landing of worn flagstones,
with a broad stairway falling steeply away into the dark. The steps are
cut from pale stone, and a cold breath from below stirs the cobwebs at
the edge. A dwarf-made lantern hook juts from the wall, empty and
rusted. The corridor leads north, and the grand stairs lead down toward
the older halls.

13116.name: A Long Corridor

north.description: To the north lies A Long Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies At The End Of A Long Hallway.

13116.description:
A Long Corridor stretches here between close walls of cold, damp stone.
A bare iron sconce hangs every few paces, though not one still holds a
torch. The floor is scattered with scraps of rotted cloth and a few
small bones, as if something had passed this way long ago. The corridor
leads north toward the throne chambers, and south to the end of a long
hallway.

13117.name: A Long Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Throne Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Chapel.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Hall Of Records.

13117.description:
A Long Corridor runs here between walls hung with the faded banners of
Durmandel's royal houses, their dwarf-forged thread gone dull as ash.
Worn flagstones, polished by centuries of royal feet, echo faintly
underfoot. Archways open north into the Throne Hall and east toward a
chapel, while the corridor stretches on south and a door of the records
hall stands to the west.

13118.name: The Throne Hall

east.description: To the east lies At The Bottom Of The Stairway.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Royal Hall.

13118.description:
The Throne Hall is a vast chamber of grey granite pillars carved with
the beards and axes of dwarf kings. A great stone throne sits on a dais
at its heart, its arms worn smooth, the cushion long since rotted to
threads. Cold braziers stand cracked and empty on every side. Archways
lead west into the Royal Hall, east to a broad stair, and south back to
the corridor.

extra_descs.throne dais stone throne:
The throne is hewn from one block of grey granite, its back carved with
a mountain and a crown. Deep grooves in the arms show where gauntleted
hands once gripped them.

13119.name: The Royal Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Royal Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Throne Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Queen's Bed Chamber.

13119.description:
The Royal Hall is a long hall of dark stone, its high ceiling hung with
the tattered remains of silk pennants. A strip of faded crimson carpet
runs down the middle, worn thin along the line where courtiers once
walked. Tall windows of grey glass cast a dim, watery light across the
floor. An archway on the east side opens to the Throne Hall, and another
passage runs west toward the queen's chamber, while the hall continues
north.

13120.name: The Royal Hall

south.description: To the south lies The Royal Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The King's Bed Chamber.

13120.description:
The royal hall ends here in a high, shadowed alcove where the pennants
hang in rotted tatters from iron poles. A heavy table of ironwood stands
against the wall, its surface carved with the runes of Durmandel's long
dynasty. Dust motes drift in the pale light of a narrow window. A
studded oak door leads west into the king's chamber, and the hall runs
back south.

13121.name: The King's Bed Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Hall.

13121.description:
The King's Bed Chamber holds a vast bed of carved ironwood, hung with
curtains of heavy brocade gone brittle and brown. Rich tapestries of
hunts and battles cover the walls, though moths have eaten holes through
the dwarf warriors' faces. A heavy iron-bound chest, long since opened
and emptied, lies at the foot of the bed. The only way out is the door
east, back into the royal hall.

13122.name: The Queen's Bed Chamber

east.description: To the east lies The Royal Hall.

13122.description:
The Queen's Bed Chamber is a small, high room hung with pale blue silk
that has faded to the colour of ash. A dressing table of inlaid bone
stands before a clouded mirror, its drawers hanging open and empty.
Dried petals lie in a crust across the floor, and the faint ghost of
lavender still lingers in the cold air. The one doorway opens east onto
the Royal Hall.

13123.name: The Chapel

east.description: To the east lies The Embalming Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies A Long Corridor.

13123.description:
The Chapel is a quiet vaulted room where rows of stone benches face an
altar of white marble veined with grey. Narrow windows of coloured glass
throw faded patches of red and blue across the floor. A basin of
stagnant water stands by the altar, and a tarnished hammer-and-anvil
symbol hangs on the wall behind. The corridor lies west, and a heavy
door leads east into a chamber that smells of spice and rot.

13124.name: The Embalming Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Burial Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Chapel.

13124.description:
The Embalming Chamber is lined with long slabs of cold stone, each one
grooved to drain away the water of the dead. Racks along the walls hold
glass jars of dry herbs, bundles of linen strips, and rusted hooks and
knives. A sharp smell of resin, myrrh and old decay clings to
everything. A door west leads out to the chapel, and an opening north
leads deeper in toward the royal dead.

13125.name: The Burial Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Burial Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Embalming Chamber.

13125.description:
The Burial Chamber is cut into a series of shallow burial niches, each
one holding a stone coffin carved with the face of a long-dead noble.
Bronze lamps hang from the ceiling on chains, though none have burned
for an age. The air is utterly still and bitterly cold, and your breath
hangs before you in a pale cloud. The embalmers' work lies south, and
the chamber goes on north.

13126.name: The Burial Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Burial Chamber.

13126.description:
The far end of the burial chamber is lined with stone coffins stacked in
heavy tiers, each marked with a name in dwarf runes. Garlands of dead
flowers crumble on the lids, and a few have slipped to scatter petals
across the stone. The silence is thick and watchful, as though the dead
are waiting. A heavy door stands to the north, leading to a hall of
honoured warriors, and the chamber ends south toward the embalmers.

13127.name: The Hall Of Heroes

east.description: To the east lies The Hall Of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies The Burial Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13127.description:
The Hall Of Heroes is a high, echoing gallery where statues of dwarf
champions stand in rows on plinths, each gripping a weapon of worn
stone. Their names are carved beneath them, and many have been scoured
by weeping and pilgrimage. Battle-torn banners droop from the rafters
above. Passages of the hall run east and west, a door leads north into a
walled place, and the burial chambers lie south.

13128.name: The Hall Of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies A Burial Mound.

east.description: To the east lies A Burial Mound.

south.description: To the south lies A Burial Mound.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13128.description:
This eastern reach of the Hall Of Heroes is lined with more statues,
their faces pitted by long ages of damp. A ring of worn shields hangs
from the wall, each one dented by a battle no one now remembers. The
floor is laid with stones of black and white, in the pattern of a
chessboard. Low openings lead north, east and south onto mounds of
earth, and the hall runs back west.

13129.name: The Hall Of Heroes

north.description: To the north lies A Burial Mound.

east.description: To the east lies The Hall Of Heroes.

south.description: To the south lies A Burial Mound.

west.description: To the west lies A Burial Mound.

13129.description:
The western arm of the Hall Of Heroes is a gallery of weapons, with
racks of notched axes and mattocks rusting where they hang. A long
mosaic along the wall shows dwarves marching to war beneath a mountain.
Grains of earth have drifted in from the mounds beyond and settled in
the corners. Openings lead north, south and west to mounds outside,
while the hall runs east toward its centre.

13130.name: A Burial Mound

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13130.description:
A Burial Mound is heaped here under a low sky, bare of all growth except
a few stalks of pale, dry grass. A shattered urn of grey clay lies
broken against the mound's flank, and a scatter of black beads mixes
with the dirt around it. Wind moans in a crack of the great wall. The
gallery lies north, the only way from this lonely place.

13131.name: A Burial Mound

east.description: To the east lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13131.description:
A Burial Mound stands here near the edge of the court, tucked against a
corner of the great wall. Tufts of rust-coloured heather cover its
crown, and a cluster of small, pale mushrooms grows at its foot. Ancient
offerings of coin and rusted nails are sunk in the soil. The only way
out is east, back into the hall.

13132.name: A Burial Mound

south.description: To the south lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13132.description:
A Burial Mound lies here in the shade of the great hall wall, its earth
heaped over a low stone cist. Moss as thick as a blanket covers the
stones, and drops of water fall slowly from the dripping eaves. The air
smells of wet clay and old iron. The way back lies south, where an arm
of the Hall Of Heroes waits.

13133.name: A Nameless Place

south.description: To the south lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13133.description:
A Nameless Place lies beyond the door, a small walled court of bare
flagstones where nothing grows. A single slab of black stone stands in
the centre, its face polished smooth and without a mark or a letter. The
sky above is a leaden, silent grey, and the wind seems to avoid the
place. The only way out is the door south, back into the hall.

extra_descs.slab black stone:
The black slab bears no name, no rune and no date. Though the stone is
cold, it feels oddly smooth, as if many hands have touched it.

13134.name: A Burial Mound

south.description: To the south lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13134.description:
A Burial Mound rises here, a grassy hump of earth ringed with a low wall
of fitted stones. A cracked headstone leans at the foot of the mound,
its rune-carved face weathered almost smooth. The grass is thin and
silvered with frost, and a damp chill breathes out of the soil. Only the
gallery of the Hall Of Heroes lies south, back through a low arch.

13135.name: A Burial Mound

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13135.description:
A Burial Mound swells here beneath a single leaning pine, its roots
gripping the stones of an old cairn. Cold white pebbles are scattered
over the earth, and a bronze axe-head, green with age, is set into the
turf as a marker. The wind sighs through the needles, and somewhere a
crow croaks. The hall gallery is the only way out, a short step west.

13136.name: A Burial Mound

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Heroes.

13136.description:
A Burial Mound slumps here, its turf sunken as though something below
had settled. A ring of weathered standing stones circles it, each cut
with the same rune of mourning. Brown thistles push through the cracks,
and a thin mist clings to the hollow. The only path leads north, back
through a low arch into the Hall Of Heroes.

13137.name: At The Bottom Of The Stairway

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Stairway.

west.description: To the west lies The Throne Hall.

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Stairway.

13137.description:
You stand at the foot of a broad stair at the end of the Throne Hall,
where the floor is scattered with flakes of old plaster fallen from the
ceiling. A tight, winding flight of narrow steps climbs from the corner
of the landing, its treads hollowed by many feet. A wide arch leads back
west into the Throne Hall, and a broad marble stair leads away east.

13138.name: A Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Bottom Of The Stairway.

13138.description:
This narrow stairway winds tightly upward through the thickness of the
wall, its steps no wider than a pair of boots. The stone is bare and
sweating, and the only light is the faint glow that filters up from the
landing below. Scratched marks of long-dead sentries cover the walls at
shoulder height, tally upon tally. The stair climbs on and drops back
toward the foot of the grand stair.

13139.name: A Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies A Narrow Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies A Narrow Stairway.

13139.description:
The narrow stairway turns sharply in the wall, forming a tiny landing no
larger than a cupboard. An arrow slit in the stone lets in a thin blade
of daylight, and a few dead leaves have blown in to rest on the step.
The air is cooler here and smells faintly of wind and bird droppings.
The stairs go on climbing, and descend again toward the lower flight.

13140.name: A Narrow Stairway

up.description: To the up lies The Look-Out.

down.description: To the down lies A Narrow Stairway.

13140.description:
The last turns of the narrow stairway end in a low, steep flight where
the walls are stained with old streaks of white. A strong draught pours
down from above, carrying the wild cry of some large bird. Loose
feathers, long and tawny, are stuck in the cracks of the steps. The
stair rises to a doorway of grey sky, and falls back the way you came.

13141.name: The Look-Out

west.description: To the west lies A Rocky Ledge.

down.description: To the down lies A Narrow Stairway.

13141.description:
The Look-Out is a ring of crumbling battlement on the highest tower of
Durmandel's halls, open to the sky and a restless wind. Far below, the
mountain valleys fold away in blue distance, and mist drifts between the
peaks. A rusted iron brazier stands in the centre, filled with old ash
and grey feathers. The stair drops back into the tower, and a narrow
ledge of rock leads west along the cliff.

13142.name: A Rocky Ledge

east.description: To the east lies The Look-Out.

west.description: To the west lies A Rocky Ledge.

13142.description:
A Rocky Ledge clings to the mountain face here, a shelf of wind-scoured
stone barely wide enough for a single traveller. Beyond the lip, the
drop plunges into a haze of cloud and distant crags. Patches of orange
lichen cover the rock, and old claw-marks gouge the stone near your
feet. The ledge leads on west and returns east to the battlements of the
Look-Out.

13143.name: A Rocky Ledge

east.description: To the east lies A Rocky Ledge.

west.description: To the west lies The Gryphon's Nest.

13143.description:
The ledge narrows as it bends around a shoulder of the mountain, the
rock slick with spray and wind-driven grit. Bones of goats and mountain
sheep lie scattered along the base of the cliff, picked clean and
bleached white. A heavy musk of beast and carrion hangs on the wind. The
path leads east back to another stretch of the ledge, and west toward a
great jumble of sticks and fur.

13144.name: The Gryphon's Nest

east.description: To the east lies A Rocky Ledge.

13144.description:
The Gryphon's Nest is a broad bowl of woven branches, bones and shed
feathers, wedged into a hollow of the cliff and as wide as a feast
table. The floor is lined with thick matted down, strewn with the gnawed
remains of mountain goats. Wind howls across the open lip of the hollow,
and the sky is a distant blue. The only way out is the ledge winding
away east.

13198.name: The Grand Stairway

west.description: To the west lies At The Bottom Of The Stairway.

down.description: To the down lies The Grand Stairway.

13198.description:
The Grand Stairway is a sweeping flight of marble steps, each one as
wide as a wagon and carved along its edges with a frieze of marching
dwarves. A pair of great bronze doors, long since green with age, stand
open to the hall behind you at the west. Below, the stairs plunge in a
wide spiral down into the darkness of the old mines, and a faint warm
draught breathes up from the deep.

650800.name: skeleton guard royal crumbling
650800.long_desc: A crumbling skeleton guard in rusted mail stands rigid at its post, a notched halberd in its bony hands.
650800.description:
The bones are yellow with age and held together by little more than
will. Faded royal livery hangs in rags from its ribs.

650801.name: ghost restless grave pale
650801.long_desc: A restless ghost drifts through the cold air, wringing hands that are no more than smoke.
650801.description:
The pale shape of a long-dead courtier wavers before you, its mouth open
in a soundless wail. Its robes flutter in a wind that you cannot feel.

650802.name: cultist embalmer hooded priest
650802.long_desc: A hooded embalmer cultist shuffles about the slabs, muttering over a jar of resin.
650802.description:
A gaunt figure in a stained grey robe, with hands blackened by years of
resin and spice. A curved bone knife hangs from a cord at his belt.

650803.name: skeleton hero champion plate
650803.short_desc: a skeletal hero in rusted plate
650803.long_desc: A skeletal hero in rusted plate armour stands among the statues, a great hammer held ready.
650803.description:
The skeleton of a dwarf champion, still wearing a battered breastplate
and a helm crowned with a ring of tarnished gold. Pale green fire burns
in its empty eye sockets.

650804.name: gryphon great wild beast
650804.long_desc: A great gryphon crouches on the rock, its hooked beak open and its eagle eyes fixed on you.
650804.description:
A huge beast with the body of a lion and the wings and head of a
mountain eagle. Its talons scrape the stone with a sound like knives on
a whetstone.

650805.name: orlen archivist ghost scribe
650805.short_desc: Orlen, the ghost of the Archivist
650805.long_desc: Orlen, the ghost of the Archivist, glides between the shelves, a quill of smoke in his hand.
650805.description:
A spectral scholar in a hooded robe, his face a gaunt mask of mist and
sorrow. Ink drips endlessly from his fingertips and vanishes before it
strikes the floor.

650806.name: durgrim dwarf king undead skeleton
650806.long_desc: Durgrim, the undead Dwarf King, sits upon his granite throne, a crowned skeleton wreathed in cold fire.
650806.description:
The bones of a mighty king, bound in a mantle of rotted ermine and
crowned with a heavy circlet of iron. He grips a mighty axe, and his
hollow gaze burns with a terrible white light.

750800.name: gilded death mask
750800.room_desc: A gilded death mask lies here, staring at nothing.
750800.description: A thin mask of beaten gold, shaped to the calm face of a dwarf noble. It is worth a good price to the right buyer.

750801.name: hero hammer warhammer heavy
750801.room_desc: A hero's warhammer lies here, its haft worn dark.
750801.description: A heavy dwarf-forged warhammer with a head of grey steel stamped with a mountain rune. The grip has been worn smooth by a champion's hands.

750802.name: gryphon feather cloak tawny
750802.room_desc: A tawny cloak of gryphon feathers lies here.
750802.description: A light cloak woven from the long tawny feathers of a mountain gryphon. It rustles like a breeze in the high crags.

750803.name: archivist signet ring silver
750803.room_desc: A silver signet ring lies here, engraved with a quill.
750803.description: A heavy silver ring bearing the seal of Durmandel's keeper of records. Ink-black runes wind about the band.

750804.name: durgrim iron crown circlet
750804.room_desc: A heavy iron crown lies here, rimed in cold frost.
750804.description: A broad circlet of black iron, set with a single grey gem and engraved with the names of forty kings. It is cold to the touch and strangely heavy.
